question.text: The activation energy for a simple chemical reaction $\mathrm{A} \rightarrow \mathrm{B}$ is $E_{a}$ in forward direction. The activation energy for reverse reaction

options.text: can be less than or more than $E_{a}$

solution.text: Since the nature of reaction (i.e. exothermic or endothermic) is not given, $\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{a}}$ for reverse reaction can be more or less.
